extracted.intended_audience: publicly traded companies, investor relations and securities compliance personnel, investors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on Regulation FD: when and to whom material nonpublic information may be disclosed and the requirement to make such information public to ensure fair disclosure. Useful for issuers preparing investor communications (e.g., press releases) to avoid selective disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to publicly disclose material nonpublic information when selectively disclosed
rubrics_metrics.description: When an issuer discloses material nonpublic information to certain individuals or entities—generally, securities market professionals (such as stock analysts) or holders of the issuer's securities who may trade on the basis of the information—the issuer must also make public disclosure of that information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to publicly traded companies and other issuers; the rule is intended to prevent selective disclosure and to promote full and fair disclosure to the market.
